description: Synthetic student profiles simulate onboarding survey answers. No LLM is used to generate profiles; they are hand-authored and script-expanded.

steps: 10 anchor profiles (CANONICAL list) cover hypothesis test personas
40 extension profiles clone anchor answer patterns with field-specific text (CS, Business, Econ, Math, Health, Humanities)
6 style-control profiles copy a partner profile except learning_1 (learning preference)

survey_fields.prereq_1: Self-rated prerequisite confidence (Very uncertain → Very confident)
survey_fields.learning_1: Preferred learning modality (Visual, Auditory, Kinesthetic, Reading/Writing, Mixed). Stored as metadata for tutor tone; must not change pathway structure.

anchor_profile_example.description: History BA sophomore, no STEM background, first AI course

answers.goals_1: Understand what AI is and how it affects society and historical research
answers.bloom_remember: I have not taken any AI or programming courses
answers.bloom_understand: Basic AI vocabulary and how historians might use AI tools
answers.bloom_apply: Use AI responsibly when reviewing sources and drafting essays
answers.bloom_analyze: I worry about technical jargon and misinformation in AI outputs

style_control_example.only_difference: learning_1 changed from Mixed approach to Kinesthetic (hands-on activities)
style_control_example.purpose: Test that learning preference does not reroute syllabus blocks
